ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, contrasted by high-intensity (white) punctate speckling and a contiguous white patch on the outer left lateral margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark mass centrally; high-intensity white patch located on the distal outer edge of the left lobe; high-frequency white punctate clusters (mottling) distributed along the vertical central axis of the fluke and peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, deep V-shaped indentation; estimated interior angle of 20-30 degrees with a significant vertical-to-horizontal depth ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations along the trailing edge; characterized by jagged peaks and narrow valleys, merging into biological clusters at the lobe terminals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe displays a sharp convex distal curvature; the right lobe exhibits a linear, diagonal upward sweep with a subtle concave inflection near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive three-dimensional clusters of high-contrast, tan and white circular calcified organisms (barnacles) localized on both distal tips of the trailing edge; dense punctate white speckling on the dark central surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive barnacle colonization (Coronula sp.) on the terminal ends of both fluke lobes; highly irregular and potentially eroded trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density white 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern concentrated specifically around the peduncle and central fluke transition.
